jobs.title: Engenheiro de Robótica
jobs.description: Quem Somos A Pronto AI é líder global na comercialização de tecnologia para veículos autônomos (AV), implementando Sistemas Autônomos de Transporte (Autonomous Haulage Systems - AHS) que automatizam operações em minas, pedreiras e canteiros de obras ao redor do mundo. Enquanto grande parte da indústria ainda está focada em pesquisa e desenvolvimento, nós entregamos soluções de autonomia reais, prontas para produção e já em operação em campo. Nossa missão é tornar as operações de mineração mais seguras, inteligentes e eficientes por meio de tecnologia de ponta. Estamos construindo o caminho para nos tornarmos a primeira empresa de tecnologia para veículos autônomos lucrativa do mundo. Sobre a oportunidade Buscamos engenheiros(as) de robótica entusiasmados por causar impacto real no mundo. Se você tem sede por desafios técnicos, gosta de colocar a mão na massa e quer trabalhar com tecnologia de ponta, colaborando com nossas equipes internacionais, esta é a sua oportunidade de participar ativamente da criação de soluções inovadoras que estão redefinindo a indústria de caminhões autônomos. A posição tem base no escritório da Pronto em Vila da Serra (Nova Lima/Belo Horizonte), com visitas ocasionais a minas no Brasil e em outros países. A jornada de trabalho pode variar conforme as necessidades operacionais. Durante o processo seletivo, é essencial responder ao questionário de experiências que acompanha a candidatura. Candidaturas sem respostas não serão consideradas. O que buscamos Responsabilidades Garantir sustentação da operação de caminhões autônomos em produção, garantindo a operação contínua e eficiente em todas as operações globais da Pronto; Executar diagnósticos e debugging em sistemas Linux, identificando e solucionando problemas em firmware, software e sistemas embarcados; Manter comunicação direta com clientes e equipes locais, atendendo às demandas operacionais e garantindo alinhamento técnico; Apoiar a instalação e integração de dispositivos em novas operações, contribuindo para a implantação e expansão das frotas; Desenvolver ferramentas de debugging e monitoramento para otimizar o suporte técnico e a análise de falhas; Desenvolver software para sistemas autônomos, colaborando com equipes internacionais em projetos de robótica avançada; Atuar em tópicos diversos da robótica, como localização, controles, planejamento de trajeto, sistemas de segurança, fusão de sensores, integração com hardware personalizado ou de terceiros, pipelines de câmeras e/ou aprendizado de máquina. Requisitos (obrigatórios) Mínimo de 2 anos de experiência profissional em desenvolvimento de software, hardware e/ou robótica; Conhecimento avançado em sistemas Linux; Experiência prática com debugging de sistemas embarcados; Experiência em conexões remotas (SSH) e ferramentas de linha de comando; Programação em Python ou C/C++ para análise e correção de códigos; Inglês avançado ou fluente, para comunicação constante com equipes globais e leitura e escrita de document

jobs.title: Integrated Testing Leader

You will also analyze issues to identify possible causes and guide development teams in finding solutions, while supporting product deployment and maintenance. This role will also support management in defining technical scope and aligning resources to customer demands, including Rumo, MRS, VLI, Vale PoC and PTC 2.0 projects. Experience writing system requirements. Experience creating test cases and knowledge in programming languages. Knowledge of agile methodologies, SCRUM, Kanban and others. Windows operating systems. Knowledge in elaboration of work effort estimates. Knowledge elaborating technical specification documents. What will your typical day look like? Plan and supervise day-to-day activities of the testing team, monitoring workload and reallocating resources when necessary. Act as the primary interface between the Integration Laboratory and other engineering segments, ensuring alignment of technical and business expectations. Mentor junior and mid-level team members, supporting their technical and professional growth. Ensure communication flow between the team, project managers, and leadership. Coordinate reporting and progress updates, consolidating information for higher management. Oversee the use of control tools (ELM, DevOps) and encourage automation initiatives to improve efficiency and traceability. Promote standardized methods and processes, fostering consistency and continuous improvement in testing practices. Track integrated tests progress. Analyze bugs and defects and propose solutions to improve the product. Elaborate work estimates. Communicate results to leadership. Support management in defining long-term testing strategies and investment needs for infrastructure and tools. Benefícios: Na Wa

jobs.title: Technical Software Engineer - MCA Platform Software
jobs.description: Job Description Essa posição é para atuar em regime presencial em Contagem, Minas Gerais. Who will you be working with? You will be part of MCA (Modular Control Architecture) software team. The MCA SW architecture is highly flexible, made up of many modular software, application, and hardware elements. While flexibility adds opportunity and capability, it also adds complexity, driving the importance of a robust platform SW and communication strategy. MCA is built on MBSE (Model Based System Engineering) principles for requirements management and test cases with full traceability built into the MBSE model. How will you make a difference? This MCA Platform Software Engineer will focus on delivering and sustaining an integrated series of board support packages (BSP), core software services, and middleware applications that are foundational to the MCA architecture. The Engineer will contribute to the definition of the strategy on which technologies to leverage, which security practices to employ, and will be responsible for implementing those strategies. This responsibility is cross functional in nature and requires close collaboration amongst various MCA teams. What do we want to know about you? Bachelor of Science in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or other Engineering discipline. Strong experience as a software engineer. Experience in developing, modifying, and debugging device drivers, bootloaders, or board support packages. Experience with Linux OS on embedded systems. Knowledge of Linux kernel internals (scheduling, memory management, IPC, file systems, etc.). Strong experience with hardware/software integration, Docker, languages such as C/C++, Bash, Python. Ability and willingness to travel as required. What will your typical day look like? Provide technical leadership to maintain high standards of software quality by establishing good practices, drive process and guide team to deliver consistently. Provide timely communications on significant issues, risks, or developments. Plan individual work for assigned MCA platform software features as input to project plans. Design, develop, maintain, and test MCA Platform SW: BSP, Platform Services, MCA Middleware applications to connect MCA Platform with Business Logic applications. Ensure MCA Platform SW is robust against expected configurability, performance, cyber security, and quality requirements. Review and refine control system-level requirements to understand design intent and reconcile with MCA Platform capabilities Derive MCA Platform software requirements and interfaces from system requirements, allocate them to MCA Platform software components. Develop, review, and execute hardware/software and software/software test plans for unit testing and MCA Platform integration testing. Lead and participate in MCA Platform software troubleshooting efforts to root cause failures and defects on the various test environments. jobs.description: At Cadence, we hire and develop leaders and innovators who want to make an impact on the world of technology. Cadence Design Systems Inc. is looking for a motivated Cybersecurity Engineer I to work with us in Belo Horizonte, Brazil. This person would join our Information Security team maintaining and enhancing our log management infrastructure, ensuring reliable, secure, and scalable ingestion of security-relevant data across the enterprise. The ideal candidate will possess knowledge in log collection technologies, SIEM administration, and SOAR integrations, with a strong focus on automation, performance optimization, and compliance. Job Description Administer and maintain log servers including upgrades, patching, and migrations. Design and implement high availability and clustering solutions for log servers. Manage log archiving, retention policies, and backup strategies. Onboard new log sources from cloud platforms, applications, network devices, and endpoints. Perform log parsing, normalization, and selective event ingestion to optimize SIEM performance. Configure streaming and forwarding mechanisms for real-time log delivery. Develop scripts (e.g., Python, Shell) for log processing, automation, and system tasks. Utilize APIs for log collection, integration, and automation workflows. Create dashboards, reports, and configure alerts for log ingestion health and security insights. Monitor data quality and ingestion anomalies, ensuring completeness and accuracy. Work closely with SOC, IR, and infrastructure teams to align log management with security operations. Document log source configurations, ingestion pipelines, and architectural decisions. Requirements Complete Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, or related field (or equivalent experience) Experience/contact with Cybersecurity: Hands-on experience with Syslog technologies (NXLOG, syslog-ng, Snare, rsyslog). Contact with log management, SIEM engineering, or security data operations. Strong Linux administration and scripting skills. Proven experience with cloud log ingestion (AWS, Azure, GCP). Familiarity with APIs and log streaming technologies. Nice To Have Certifications such as Splunk Certified Architect, Elastic Certified Engineer, CISSP, GIAC. Experience with SOAR platforms and playbook development. Familiarity with containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes) and their logging mechanisms. Additional Job Details Employment category: CLT Employment term: 40 hours/week. Competitive benefits. Location: Av Contorno 5800, Belo Horizonte, Minas Gerais Brazil.
